notes: Design, settled at planning 2026-10-28: bl_authority.disposition(item, gate) gives block (start gate, --kind blocking, a class of the gate's own text among ceiling, secrets, push, agents-rule, querylog or delete, a strict signal, an option naming a path outside the touches or a rule-text path: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .claude-plugin/, skills/, agents/, or the item's title giving secrets, push, ceiling or querylog), hold (any other gate whose touch-derived class is an operator class) or agent; the class stays derived as now, so kbdecide, bl_plan's start gate and horizon read it unchanged; check accepts a held gate that is provisional or agent-answered; set --touch re-derives each gate and a held gate that now blocks turns blocking; kb/_self/backlog.md (Rule-guarding work, Gate classes) and kb/_self/tools.md describe it; the item skill's step 5 says, as agents/worker.md does, that a worker goes on with the recommendation of a gate made blocking mid-work, which delivers ST-nq4pme2q (dropped at the sprint's close).
